race.comment: VANLEE (7) was last at the races when she finished 13th over 1100m at Morphettville on May 30. Resumes now in much easier company and typically goes well fresh. Hard to hold out. GUSTY WAY (3) turned in a strong run two starts ago at Naracoorte then failed to back it up over 1400m at Morphettville Parks last time, beaten 5 lengths into fifth. Looks better placed this trip and grade and can bounce back. SQUAD (6) has been below his best his past couple but is up to these on best form. ARTISSI (5) has not raced since finishing third over 1100m at Morphettville on May 30. Has featured fresh previously and can contest for a place.
